svg.title: file-password-remover
svg.desc: Local-first tool. 0 bytes uploaded. Strips passwords from PDF, Office, ZIP and 7-Zip files you own, entirely offline, and re-opens every output to verify it before writing. Building it surfaced the py7zr hang I fixed upstream. Built with Python, pikepdf, msoffcrypto, py7zr.

g.text: Strips passwords from PDF, Office, ZIP and 7-Zip files you own,
entirely offline, and re-opens every output to verify it before
writing. Building it surfaced the py7zr hang I fixed upstream.
